cover.alt: A young player studies a fantasy game shop with virtual coins and outfits at a cozy desk.

blocks.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Many games are fun and free to start. But the people who make them need money. Roblox, Fortnite, and phone games earn money in different ways. A smart player also thinks before buying.

items.prompt: Do you play Roblox, Fortnite, or another game?
items.answer: For example: I play Roblox with my friends.

items.prompt: Have you seen a shop inside a game?
items.answer: For example: Yes. I saw clothes and coins in the shop.

items.prompt: What can people buy in a game?
items.answer: They can buy skins, characters, coins, passes, and other items.

blocks.title: Part 1 — Why Games Need Money
paragraphs: Games are fun, but they are also a business. A team works every day to make every game, and some people write code or draw pictures. Other people make music, fix problems, and help players. The company must pay these workers and make new things. A server lets people play online, and the company pays for it. Some games cost money when you buy them. Roblox and Fortnite are free to start. They need other ways to make money over time.

images.alt: One player buys a boxed game while another starts a free tablet game with an optional item shop.

items.prompt: Why do game companies need money?
items.answer: They need money to pay workers, make new things, and run the game online.

blocks.title: Part 2 — Shops Inside Games
paragraphs: Free games often have a shop inside the game. Players use real money to buy game money. Roblox calls its game money Robux, and Fortnite calls its game money V-Bucks. Players can buy skins, characters, coins, and other items. A skin only changes how a character looks. Fortnite also sells a Battle Pass with rewards. Some passes give players more things as they play. These things can be fun, but players do not need them to play.

images.alt: Arrows show money from a wallet changing into game coins and then a digital outfit.

items.prompt: How can a free game make money?
items.answer: It can sell game money, skins, items, or a pass. It can also use ads.

blocks.title: Part 3 — Ads and Special Events
paragraphs: Games can make money from ads too. In many phone games, a player can watch a short ad. The player may get coins or an extra life. The game company gets money when people watch. Roblox can also show ads inside a game world. Games also have events with rare or limited items. These items feel special because they are not always there. Many players come back and may buy something during the event.

items.prompt: How do ads and events help a game make money?
items.answer: The company gets money when people watch ads. Events bring players back, and some players buy something.

blocks.title: Part 4 — Updates and Smart Spending
paragraphs: Game companies want players to stay interested for a long time. They add new maps, characters, missions, and rewards. Fortnite often starts a new season with new things. An update can make the game feel fresh and bring many players back. A shop may say that an item is here for a short time. This can make a player want to buy it now. It is smart to stop, check the real price, and think before you buy. Buy only something you will use and can pay for.

images.alt: A young player pauses between a limited-time outfit and a savings jar before choosing.

items.prompt: What can a game add to keep players interested?
items.answer: It can add new maps, characters, missions, rewards, events, or a new season.

items.prompt: Do you think a skin is worth buying? Why or why not?
items.answer: It may be worth it if you like it, will use it often, and can pay for it. Check the real price first.
